entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Python libraries such as Flask, SciPy, scikit-learn, Keras, and PyTorch
Transformers like BERT, GPT, and LLaMA
reading.format: Delivered as a 16-course series on Coursera. Includes a guided project, hands-on labs, projects, and practical evaluations. Available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: The IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 16-course series from IBM on Coursera. It covers generative AI, large language models, natural language processing, and related Python tools. The page says it takes about 6 months and requires no prior experience. Completing it is presented as showing employers practical experience in building and deploying generative AI applications.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring gen AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI research engineers.
reading.prerequisites: No prior experience required. Beginner level.
